text: The New York rare book dealer Dean Corso is hired by the wealthy collector Boris Balkan to [authenticate a 17th century book said to summon the Devil|trigger|digging into a mystery], one of three surviving copies. Travelling to Toledo, Sintra and Paris, shadowed by a mysterious woman he calls Green Eyes, he finds [engravings signed LCF for Lucifer|images|books, letters and writing], while the people around the books turn up [hanged, drowned and strangled|threat|people who kill]. At the end of the trail waits a remote castle and a rite [to call up the Devil|rules|calling it brings it].
